ModMetaData.name: Rim Chronicles
ModMetaData.author: OldmanJohnnyMorgan
ModMetaData.description:
A story mode for RimWorld 1.7: plots with acts, stakes and endings, grown from what actually happened to your colony and narrated by a language model running on your own PC.
- The Rim Dispatch: a reporter covers the rim every few days. - Minor plots from your colony's history: Nemesis, Lost Family, Silent Press. - A plot director that knows when to move a story on and when to let the colony breathe. - The Awakened Empire (needs Royalty): a game-long arc with three endings and an epilogue. - The Imperial crisis (needs Royalty): oppose the Empire and it comes for you with skilled troops, real psycasts, orbital strikes, sites to raid and a three-ringed Citadel to storm. - The Hollow Choir and the War in Heaven (needs Biotech and Royalty): the Empire's ancient mechanite enemy wakes. Pick a side, or stand alone against both, until the two powers go to war and one side wins.
Works without a model too: every text has a written template. For narration, run Ollama (or any OpenAI-compatible server) and pick a tier in the mod settings.
Early preview: back up your saves. Source and license (MIT): https://github.com/OldmanJohnnyMorgan/RimChronicles
